name: Tachikoma x pi-mono Fusion Regression Suite
description: Unified regression entry for the tachikoma-pi-mono fusion plan (recoverable errors, pi-core profile, mid-smoke, todo FSM/resume, compaction, replay idempotency).

cases.objective: Attempt a task where a suggested tool is unavailable, recover from TOOL_NOT_FOUND by switching to available tools, and complete the task.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the agent avoid hard failure after unknown tool and continue using available tools?

cases.objective: When receiving a synthetic unknown-tool error, continue by selecting an alternative tool path and finish without terminating the subtask.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the trajectory continue after synthetic error instead of aborting?

cases.objective: Invoke a tool with missing required arguments, observe TOOL_VALIDATION_ERROR, correct the arguments, and succeed on retry.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the agent repair tool input after validation failure and retry successfully?

cases.objective: Send malformed tool input payload, then adjust payload shape according to error hint and complete the operation without subtask failure.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the agent convert invalid payload schema into a valid one using returned hint?

cases.objective: Under pi-core profile, ignore unavailable recommended tools and finish the task using only read/write/edit/bash equivalents.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the agent stay within pi-core tools after preflight sanitization?

cases.objective: Use pi-core aliases in constraints and execute successfully after alias mapping to Tachikoma native tools.
Modify backend API route files and continue execution after receiving a System Observer probe that asks for health check/testing validation.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the agent react to probe guidance and run verification-oriented actions?

cases.objective: Change frontend entrypoint or mock wiring and follow injected observer guidance to validate rendering/startup before moving on.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the workflow surface integration risk mid-execution rather than at final gate?

cases.objective: Create a multi-step todo list with todowrite, keep exactly one item in_progress, then call todoread and summarize revision plus pending/in_progress/completed counts.
Intentionally use todowrite with a stale baseRevision to trigger a revision mismatch, then recover by reading latest state with todoread and retry todowrite successfully.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the agent recover from stale baseRevision by refreshing todo state and retrying instead of aborting?

cases.objective: Simulate a long multi-step execution with many constraints so that session compaction is triggered, then continue execution and report sessionCompactionSummaryHash, todoSnapshotHash, and todoRevision in the final summary.
After compaction is triggered in a long run, complete the originally requested goal without restarting finished todo items and explicitly mention what was already completed before compaction.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the agent preserve task intent across compaction and avoid reopening completed todo items?

cases.objective: Attempt an illegal todo transition from pending directly to completed and recover by using a valid transition path.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the agent avoid accepting illegal FSM transition and then recover with legal sequence?

cases.objective: Try to set multiple todo items to in_progress at once, observe rejection, and resolve to exactly one in_progress item.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the final state enforce the single in_progress invariant?

cases.objective: Given a stale todoSnapshotHash in constraints plus a newer session todo snapshot, continue planning with the latest todo state and report that mismatch was detected and corrected.

When compaction summary says an item is completed but authoritative todo snapshot marks it pending, follow todo snapshot, do not skip execution, and include conflictPolicy=todo_wins in the final output.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the agent prioritize todo snapshot over summary state and avoid false replay completion?

cases.objective: Treat subtask 1.1 as already completed, verify current todo state with todoread, and avoid duplicate completion side effects. Final summary must include: idempotent replay skip.
When reporting a replay-guard skip outcome, include subtaskId, eventId, todoHash, and todoRevision in the final output, and avoid re-running the completed step.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the trajectory avoid duplicate completion work and provide a replay fingerprint payload?
